## Nextpower Awarded New U.S. Patent for NX Horizon-XTR Terrain-following Technology


November 18, 2026


Patent protects a torque tube design that follows uneven terrain, helping reduce grading, site preparation costs, and barriers to solar development


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power technology solutions, today announced that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office has issued U.S. Patent No. 12,803,495 for technology used in its NX Horizon-XTR™ terrain-following solar tracker. The patent includes a tracker with a torque tube design that follows changes in terrain elevation, helping solar developers build on more challenging sites with less grading and earthworks.


Nextpower Awarded New U.S. Patent for NX Horizon-XTR Terrain-following Technology


Nextpower’s pioneering terrain-following tracker has been deployed on projects representing dozens of gigawatts across multiple continents since its launch.


Most utility-scale solar sites are not flat. Conventional tracker designs often require extensive grading to maintain a consistent tracker profile. Developers may instead use custom-length piers, which must be specified and installed at precise locations across a site. Both approaches can add cost, time, and complexity.


Nextpower's patented design uses a torque tube engineered with the flexibility to change angle as it spans foundation piles at varying elevations. This helps the tracker follow changes in elevation while maintaining a consistent pier reveal along a row, supporting standardized pier sizes and a more efficient installation.


By reducing or eliminating the amount of earth that must be moved, NX Horizon-XTR can help preserve topsoil, support healthy vegetation, and reduce erosion potential. Minimizing grading can also help projects address permitting and community concerns.


This is the second patent issued in this technology family, following U.S. Patent No. 12,301,164, issued May 13, 2025. Nextpower holds more than 1,600 issued patents and pending patent applications supporting innovation across its clean power technology portfolio.


To learn more about Nextpower’s terrain-following tracker solutions, visit[https://nextpower.com/products/trackers/nx-horizon-xtr](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fproducts%2Ftrackers%2Fnx-horizon-xtr&esheet=54643497&newsitemid=20261118797260&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fproducts%2Ftrackers%2Fnx-horizon-xtr&index=1&md5=64fbedb43d4bfeb9b288f834177e3841)

Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) innovates and delivers integrated technology solutions for modern energy infrastructure.
